thesis_triggers.event: Reviewed 2026-11-04, unchanged at $185: Q3 confirmed growth (+55.5%) and margins (84.3%); $185 is well below our downside (P10) case. Net debt is now 342.4 (9-30) and the buyback authorization $3.6B after October's $3.2B raise (src 46, 47). Earlier review (2026-10-30, figures as of then): Reviewed 2026-10-30, unchanged at $185: the -10.4% on Oct 30 had no company news (sector AI selloff, src 25) and the close of $228.50 is still ~24% above it; $185 is ~9.2x our FY2027 model EPS and sits just above our downside (P10) case of ~$174. At about $185 the stock trades at about 9.4x FY27 Zacks consensus EPS ($19.63, 11-04 snapshot), about 7-8x EBITDA and a 10%+ FCF yield, with about $0.46B of net debt and $1.8B of buyback authorization left at 6-30. A sustained trade there would mean the market expects earnings to fall, not just growth to slow. Likely causes: a Q4 guide implying flat or negative q/q revenue, visible MAX/Axon share or spread loss to Unity Vector (now growing about 16% q/q), a loss in the Unity dispute that exposes MAX auction data, an Apple/Google platform action, or a damaging litigation development. The agents' mean is $185 (range $180-195); it sits about one 12-month sigma below spot.
